## Three days on the Amazon

The small boat can leave the main river channel and reach quieter waters where it’s easier to watch birds and other wildlife. The itinerary includes early-morning trips on the water, outings after sunset, piranha fishing and a visit to a flooded forest.

The Amazon Clipper accommodates up to 16 guests in eight cabins. Each cabin has air conditioning and a private bathroom with a shower. The riverboat also has a covered dining area, a bar, a library and an open-air upper deck with views in every direction.
